commitSubject: Sync Slack's native theme with Omarchy (#17113)
summary: Omarchy 4 replaces Waybar, Walker/Elephant, Mako, SwayOSD, Hyprlock, Hypridle, swaybg and polkit-gnome with one long-running Quickshell (QML) process, omarchy-shell, and moves Hyprland config from .conf to Lua.

dirs.purpose: omarchy-* commands (theme, menu, launch, hyprland, install, toggle, capture...). Installed to /usr/bin.
The Quickshell desktop: bar, Omarchy menu, notifications, OSD, lock screen, dock, panels, polkit, image picker. Installed to /usr/share/omarchy/shell.

Omarchy-managed defaults read in place from /usr/share/omarchy/default: Hyprland Lua modules, theme templates (default/themed/*.tpl), menu definition, plymouth and SDDM themes, fontconfig, icon font, i18n strings. Not meant to be edited.
User-editable dotfiles seeded into ~/.config through /etc/skel (hypr/*.lua overrides, terminal configs, omarchy/shell.json, menu extension sample, hook samples).
23 first-party themes (colors.toml plus optional overrides, backgrounds, previews).
.desktop launchers for preinstalled web apps and default apps, plus their icons.
Install/finalize scripts and package lists (omarchy-base.packages etc.).
One-shot upgrade scripts run on update.
System /etc drop-ins (sddm.conf.d, fastfetch, kitty system config, xkb compose option, NetworkManager, sudoers...).
The user manual: 51 English chapters plus 50 locale directories. Repo only.
Developer reference (theming, shell, menu, notifications, file layout...). Repo only.
CLI, shell, acceptance and CI-VM test suites. Repo only.
Contributor task guides (skills) for coding agents. Repo only.
JSON acceptance scenarios (lock screen, menu, workspace switching...).
Design plans (backup, dots, remote, server). Repo only.

css.notable: No CSS: QML. Workspace buttons are 20px wide x 26px tall, 1px apart, text 12px, horizontal margin 6, vertical padding 6.
